platinum.mission_replay: none — no mission replay, no New Game+

stages.note: Do the balcony meditation the morning after Down to Earth — it is the only spot that disappears. Finish the chapter, try an arcade game, and meet the first story contacts.
stages.title: Chapter 1 — First steps in Leonida

stages.note: Story missions plus your first activities: fishing against Cal, bowling at Kolt & Associates, and sampling new activity types as they unlock.
stages.title: Chapter 2 — Vice City opens up

stages.note: Start the stranger strands, race Yago when the hourglass icon appears, and steal the VCIA plane as soon as you can reach the airport — both windows are disputed, so do them now.
stages.title: Chapter 3 — Strangers, races and VCIA

stages.note: Finish the chapter missions, including VCIA Takedown and Operation Savage Glory, and try a 4-star wanted escape with your partner.
stages.title: Chapter 4 — The story tightens

stages.note: Play the final mission to the end. There is no mission replay, so make a manual save before the finale if you want a clean rollback point.
stages.title: Finale — The final mission

stages.note: The long tail: side strands, collectibles, activities, robberies, hunts, challenges and money trophies. Work region by region and let the counters guide you.
stages.title: Free-roam cleanup — Everything left

stages.note: Close out the 35-row 100% checklist, then the platinum pops with it. The last rows are the grindiest thresholds — cards, WAiNK, stunts and challenges.
stages.title: 100% + Platinum — A Long Road

thresholds: Meditations: 15 of 18 (trophy target itself is disputed, 15 vs 18)
Drone time trials: 42 across 14 Top Fun locations
Bank vaults: 8 in the world (trophy needs 5)
Must be finished in full: every robbery, all 33 underwater discoveries, all Shooting Range golds, all drone races, all 15 of Bret's Target Decks
weights_note: Group weights (Story & Tasks 45%, Exploration & Activities 45%, Discovery 10%) come from GTABase alone — single-source.
